title: Product Manager - myRico
description:
Product Manager - myRico

HSR, Bangalore, India

Mission

The best teams spend too much time keeping work moving. Context is scattered across conversations, documents and tools. Decisions get lost. Dependencies go unnoticed. Someone has to remember what matters, connect the dots and follow through.

We’re building myRico to help carry that work.

Our ambition is an AI teammate that understands your company—its goals, people, decisions and ways of working—and uses that understanding to help the team get things done. A teammate that earns trust through useful work, sound judgment and dependable follow-through.

Our starting point is helping software teams move projects from intent to delivery. Success means less effort spent coordinating and correcting work, and a shorter path to an outcome the team can stand behind.

The role

We’re hiring our founding Product Manager to help turn that ambition into a product that teams rely on every day.

You’ll work closely with the founders, engineers and early customers to figure out where Rico creates the most value, what we should build next and whether it actually works. You’ll own the loop from understanding a problem to shipping a solution, watching people use it and making it better.

Some of the hardest questions are also the most interesting. When should Rico act on its own? When should it ask? What should it remember? How does it earn permission to take on more responsibility? How do we know it has saved someone time once we account for the effort of directing, reviewing and correcting it?

In practice, you might spend a morning watching a customer run a project, prototype a better workflow that afternoon, and work with engineering to put it in their hands that week. You’ll read conversations, investigate failures, challenge assumptions and make the small product decisions that determine whether an AI teammate feels useful or exhausting.

You’ll help shape both the product and how we build it. That means choosing a few problems worth solving deeply, making clear tradeoffs and staying accountable for what happens after launch.

This role is based in Bangalore and would require 5 days in office.

What we’re looking for

  • Customer obsession. You get close enough to users to understand how their work actually happens, including the workarounds they’ve stopped noticing.

  • Product judgment. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a clear decision about what to build, what to leave out and what evidence would change your mind.

  • A builder’s instinct. You use prototypes, experiments and AI tools to make ideas tangible and learn quickly.

  • Technical fluency. You can reason with engineers about AI behavior, memory, integrations, permissions and the tradeoffs between quality, latency and cost.

  • Care for the details. You notice when an interaction creates confusion, a notification interrupts at the wrong time or a confident answer hasn’t earned that confidence.

  • Ownership. You follow a problem through discovery, delivery and adoption. You stay with it when the first solution falls short.

  • Clear communication. You write precisely, explain your reasoning and disagree thoughtfully.

Experience

You’ve helped take a product or meaningful feature from an unclear problem to real usage. You can explain the decisions you made, the tradeoffs you accepted and what you learned when users surprised you.

Your background might be product management, engineering, design or founding a company. We care about evidence of good judgment and useful things you’ve shipped.

This role will be a poor fit if

  • You need a fully defined roadmap before you can make progress.

  • You prefer handing off requirements to staying involved through implementation and adoption.

  • You’re uncomfortable spending substantial time with customers or examining where the product fails.

  • You find it difficult to change direction when the evidence challenges your original idea.

Bonus

  • You’ve built an AI product and dealt with its behavior in real use.

  • You’ve worked on collaboration tools, developer products or complex business workflows.

  • You’ve been a founder or an early employee at a startup.

  • You can build working prototypes yourself.

title: À la carte tarjoilijoita keikkatöihin, Oulu
description:
Kiinnostaisiko joustava keikkatyö ravintola-alan hommissa? Meiltä löytyy vaihtelevia hommia monentasoisille osaajille. Jatka lukemista, niin kerromme lissää!

Oulussa asiakkaillamme on tarvetta erilaisiin tarjoilijan tehtäviin. Työtehtäviä on eri ala carte ravintoloissa sekä esimerkiksi juhlallisissa tilaisuuksissa.

Edellytämme sinulta työkokemusta tarjoilijan tehtävistä á la carte ravintolassa. Asiakaspalvelu tulisi tulla sinulta jo luonnostaan ja lautaset sekä tarjotin tulisi pysyä käsissä.

Työt sijoittuvat enimmäkseen iltoihin sekä viikonloppuihin joten työ sopii myös lisätyönä tai vaikka opiskelujesi ohelle.

Työ on pääsääntöisesti keikkatyötä mutta sinulla on myös mahdollisuus työllistyä kauttamme kokoaikaisesti, katsomme tilanteesi kokonaisuutena.

Keikkatyö avaa uusia mahdollisuuksia eri asiakasyrityksillemme, ja hyvänä puolena siinä on joustavuus, teet töitä silloin ja sen verran kun sinulle soppii.

Valittu henkilö työllistyy Lisäpalvelu Pohjois-Suomi Oy:n kautta ja saa meiltä kaiken tuen ja turvan koko meillä työllistymisen ajan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

* Hymy ei hyydy asiakaspalvelutilanteissa.
* Olet loistava tiimipelaaja.
* Sinulta löytyy ongelmanratkaisu taitoja
* Kokemusta ravintola-alalta ja/tai alan koulutus.
* Suomenkielen osaaminen on välttämätön.
* Hygienia- ja anniskelupassi.
* Täysi-ikäisyyttä.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

* Palkkauksen osaamisesi mukaan, joka on aina vähintään alan työehtosopimuksen mukainen.
* Apua ja tukea työssä tarvittavien korttien ja koulutusten hankkimiseen.
* Luotettavan työpaikan, jossa kaikki työsuhteeseen liittyvät asiat hoituvat.

Tässä vielä muutama syy, miksi sinun kannattaa valita Lisäpalvelu:

1. Meillä saat työnhakijana ja -tekijänä aidosti henkilökohtaista palvelua. Tapaat meidät kasvotusten jo työnhakuvaiheessa. Kun työllistyt kauttamme, saat meiltä yhteyshenkilön, joka auttaa sinua kaikissa työsuhteeseen liittyvissä asioissa.
2. Ravintola-alan asiakaskuntamme on monipuolinen. Siksi pystymme tarjoamaan laajan kattauksen erilaisia tehtäviä, joista löytyy jokaiselle jotakin.
3. Pidämme kiinni sovituista asioista ja teemme sen, mitä lupaamme. Sinä voit keskittyä työntekoon, koska me hoidamme puolestasi ylimääräisen byrokratian.



Kuulostaako hyvältä? Hienoa, haluamme kuulla sinusta pian!

Jos saimme sinut kiinnostumaan ja haluaisit liittyä Lisäpalvelun porukkaan, laita meille hakemus tulemaan!

Haethan vain hakuilmoituksen kautta ja liitä myös cv:si hakemukseen.

Jäikö sinulle kysyttävää? Lisätietoja: tiia-maria.sillankorva@lisapalvelu.net tai Tiia-Maria Sillankorva 040-1974678



Lisäpalvelu on vuonna 2002 perustettu valtakunnallisesti toimiva joustavia henkilöstöratkaisuja tarjoava kotimainen yritys. Lisäpalvelu-konserni on tunnettu luotettavuudesta ja pitkäaikaisista asiakassuhteista niin työnantajien kuin -tekijöiden keskuudessa. Työllistämme vuosittain yli 3 000 työntekijää, ja olemme vahva toimija monella alalla: tarjoamme töitä mm. ravintola-, rakennus-, teollisuus-, kunnossapito-, logistiikka-, toimisto-, siivous- ja kaupan aloilla. Olemme Suomen kymmenen suurimman henkilöstöpalvelualan yrityksen joukossa, ja kuulumme Henkilöstöpalveluyritysten liittoon (HPL).

Haluamme tehdä töihin menon sinulle helpoksi: kauttamme voit työllistyä parhaimmillaan jo seuraavana päivänä. Tarjoamme jatkuvasti töitä erilaisiin elämäntilanteisiin, ja kauttamme tehty vuokratyö on ollut monelle työntekijällemme reitti vakituiseen työsuhteeseen.

Etsimme nyt kokkeja huippu tiimiin Rukalle!

Tarjoamme nyt mahdollisuutta päästä työskentelemään upeassa ravintolassa tunturin huipulla! Ympärille avautuu ihanat ja monipuoliset harrastus mahdollisuudet sekä pääset tutustumaan mahtaviin ihmisiin koko tunturissa joten aika kuluu varmasti loistavasti!

Työnkuvaan kuuluu á la carte ruokien valmistus ja esillelaitto. Sekä muut keittiöön kuuluvat työt.

Vaatimuksenamme on alan koulutus ja vähintään 2 vuoden kokemus à la carte keittiössä työskentelystä. Edellytämme sinulta joustavaa oma-alotteista asennetta, osaat toimia keittiössä hyvin itsenäisesti sekä yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa.

Aloitus 18.11.2026 ja kesto 18.4.2027 saakka.

Palkkaus osaamisesi mukaan noin 15-17€/h ja tarvittaessa sinulle järjestyy majoitus työpaikan lähettyviltä huokeaan hintaan!

Valittu henkilö työllistyy Lisäpalvelu Pohjois-Suomi Oy:n kautta ja tarjoamme myös Lisäpalvelun tuen ja turvan koko matkasi ajan. Huolehdimme että kaikki menee kuten on sovittu ja että viihdyt kohteessa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

* Vähintään 2 vuotta työkokemusta a`la carte ruoan valmistuksesta.
* Olet loistava tiimipelaaja mutta pystyt toimiaan keittiössä myös itsenäisesti.
* Sinulla on hyvää asennetta työntekoon ja halua oppia uutta.
* Kyky sopeutua muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja taito ottaa myös muut huomioon.
* Suomenkielen taito välttämätön.
* Hygieniapassi.

Mitä me tarjoamme sinulle?

* Kilpailukykyisen palkan osaamisesi mukaan, joka on aina vähintään alan työehtosopimuksen mukainen.
* Tarvittaessa sinulle löytyy myös majoitus huokeaan hintaan.
* Sinä saat Lisäpalvelun tuen ja turvan koko matkasi ajan. Huolehdimme että kaikki menee tunturissa kuten on sovittu ja että viihdyt kohteessa.
* Käymme sinua välillä tervehtimässä ihan paikan päällä. Sinä voit siis keskittyä itse työntekoon ja luonnosta nauttimiseen.
* Työterveyspalvelut.
* Mahdollisuuden kehittyä ammatissa loistavissa puitteissa.
* Vuokraamme sinulle auton tarvittaessa.

Tässä vielä muutama syy, miksi sinun kannattaa valita Lisäpalvelu:

1. Meillä saat työnhakijana ja -tekijänä aidosti henkilökohtaista palvelua. Kun työllistyt kauttamme, saat meiltä yhteyshenkilön, joka auttaa sinua kaikissa työsuhteeseen liittyvissä asioissa.
2. Ravintola-alan asiakaskuntamme on monipuolinen. Siksi pystymme tarjoamaan laajan kattauksen eri tuntureissa ja erilaisia työtehtäviä, joista löytyy jokaiselle jotakin.
3. Pidämme kiinni sovituista asioista ja teemme sen, mitä lupaamme. Sinä voit keskittyä työntekoon, koska me hoidamme puolestasi ylimääräisen byrokratian.



Kuulostaako hyvältä? Hienoa, haluamme kuulla sinusta pian!

Jos saimme sinut kiinnostumaan ja haluaisit liittyä Lisäpalvelun porukkaan, laita meille hakemusta tulemaan!

Haethan vain hakuilmoituksen kautta ja liitä myös cv:si hakemukseen.

Lisätietoja: ilari.kesti@lisapalvelu.net tai puhelimitse +358401966174



Lisäpalvelu on vuonna 2002 perustettu valtakunnallisesti toimiva joustavia henkilöstöratkaisuja tarjoava kotimainen yritys. Lisäpalvelu-konserni on tunnettu luotettavuudesta ja pitkäaikaisista asiakassuhteista niin työnantajien kuin -tekijöiden keskuudessa. Työllistämme vuosittain yli 3 000 työntekijää, ja olemme vahva toimija monella alalla: tarjoamme töitä mm. ravintola-, rakennus-, teollisuus-, kunnossapito-, logistiikka-, toimisto-, siivous- ja kaupan aloilla. title: Logistiikan kenttäkouluttajaksi Kärkkäisen joulusesonkiin, Ylivieska
description:
Etsimme Treamerin tiimiin kahta logistiikan kenttäkouluttajaa vahvistamaan Kärkkäisen Ylivieskan logistiikan sesonkia.

Kärkkäisen logistiikassa työskentelee sesongin aikana noin 20–30 Treamerin työntekijää oman tiimin tukena. Haluamme varmistaa, että uudet tekijät pääsevät aloittamaan työnsä hallitusti, saavat yhtenäisen perehdytyksen ja että työnjohdolla on sesongin kiireessä riittävästi tukea arjen ohjaamiseen.

Kenttäkouluttajana työskentelet osana Kärkkäisen logistiikan päivittäistä toimintaa. Teet myös itse varastotyötä, mutta päävastuusi on uusien Treamer-tekijöiden vastaanotossa, perehdytyksessä, työn opastuksessa ja arjen tukemisessa. Toimit läheisessä yhteistyössä Kärkkäisen työnjohdon ja Treamerin tiimin kanssa.

Työ alkaisi suunnitellusti noin viikolla 43, jotta ehdit perehtyä toimintaan ja rakentaa valmiutta ennen sesongin käynnistymistä viikolla 47.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

- perehdyt Kärkkäisen logistiikan keskeisiin työtehtäviin ja toimintatapoihin

- vastaanotat ja perehdytät uusia Treamer-tekijöitä

- opastat tekijöitä käytännön työssä ja varmistat, että työn aloitus sujuu turvallisesti ja yhtenäisesti

- toimit matalan kynnyksen tukena työntekijöille ja työnjohdolle

- välität havaintoja perehdytyksen, työn sujuvuuden ja tekijöiden osaamisen kehittämiseksi

- osallistut tarvittaessa Treamerin poolin, työvuorojen ja resurssitarpeiden koordinointiin

- kehität kanssamme tulevaisuuden perehdytys- ja koulutusmallia Kärkkäiselle.

Toivomme sinulta

- aiempaa kokemusta esimerkiksi vuorovastaavan, perehdyttäjän, kouluttajan tai tiiminvetäjän tehtävistä, ehkä jopa Kärkkäseltä aiemmin

- kiinnostusta logistiikkaan ja käytännön varastotyöhön; aiempi logistiikkakokemus on etu, mutta ei välttämätön

- rauhallista ja selkeää tapaa ohjata erilaisia ihmisiä

- kykyä toimia nopeatempoisessa ympäristössä ja muuttuvissa tilanteissa

- oma-aloitteisuutta sekä aitoa halua kehittää toimintaa yhdessä asiakkaan ja Treamerin tiimin kanssa

- valmiutta työskennellä aamu- ja iltavuoroissa (ma-pe 7-23 ja viikonloppuisin 7-15, sesongin aikana pooli työskentelee läpi vuorokauden)

- sujuvaa suomenkielen taitoa

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden olla rakentamassa uutta kenttäkouluttajamallia yhdessä Kärkkäisen ja Treamerin kanssa. Roolissa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten uusia tekijöitä perehdytetään, miten arjen tieto kulkee ja miten sesongin henkilöstökapasiteetti saadaan toimimaan mahdollisimman hyvin.

Työ on sesongissa kokoaikainen, keskimäärin 37,5 tuntia viikossa. Työ alkaa viikolla 43 ja painottuu sesonkikauteen. Palkkaus määräytyy Kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen sekä tehtävän vastuun ja aiemman kokemuksesi perusteella. Treamer maksaa tehtävästä erikseen kouluttajan lisää n. 150-300e/kk.

Treamer käsittelee hakemukset, haastattelee valittavat henkilöt ja solmii työsuhteen. Toivomme, että annat Kärkkäisen työnjohdolle työrauhan rekrytointiprosessin aikana.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi vastaamalla esikarsintakysymyksiin — etenemme haastatteluissa jo hakuaikana.

Mikä on Treamer?

Treamer rakentaa uuden sukupolven henkilöstöpalvelua yhdistämällä teknologian, tekoälyn ja vahvan operatiivisen osaamisen. Yli 160 000 rekisteröityneen käyttäjän työelämäverkosto, oma teknologia sekä premium-tason kohdevastaavamalli auttavat asiakkaitamme rakentamaan aidosti joustavia ja laadukkaita henkilöstöratkaisuja. MEKO on yksi Treamerin strategisista asiakkuuksista, jossa rakennetaan uudenlaista toimintamallia henkilöstön saatavuuden, perehdytyksen, osaamisen ja päivittäisen operatiivisen johtamisen tueksi.

title: Intake Case Specialist -  2025906
description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.
ORGANIZATION SUMMARY
World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a Case Manager to deliver comprehensive support and ongoing community orientation to immigrant families. In this role, you will help clients navigate detention services, enroll children in school, access medical care, apply for public benefits, and connect with external community resources.

This is a limited-term position funded through a grant agreement until 6/30/2027 and contingent upon funding extension.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments with immigrant families, asylum seekers, parolees, and visa holders to identify needs, overcome barriers, and connect them with appropriate community resources.
  • Assist families in accessing and understanding public benefits programs, including Medicaid, All Kids, VTTC, and WIC.
  • Orient participants to the healthcare system by helping schedule and attend appointments, arranging or providing transportation, and assisting with physician communication.
  • Educate families on navigating their new surroundings in Chicagoland and research community resources, such as food pantries, housing support, ESL classes, healthcare, and legal services.
  • Maintain timely, accurate, and confidential digital and physical client files, case notes, and internal database tracking systems.
  • Actively participate in team meetings, program trainings, and supervision check-ins while applying trauma-informed practices and high confidentiality standards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • Valid drivers license, access to reliable vehicle and ability to pass MVR standards

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Human Services, International Relations, or a related field (or equivalent combination of education and/or direct service experience/customer service experience).
  • Personal or professional understanding of the immigrant experience and navigation of local social service systems.
  • Proficiency or fluency in a second language spoken by local client communities (e.g., Spanish, Dari, Pashto, Ukrainian, Russian, Arabic or French) highly preferred.
  • Knowledge of and experience working with traumatized populations, utilizing trauma-informed approaches and strengths-based practices.
  • Highly self-motivated and adaptable, with a strong ability to work independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong mediation, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with a track record of effective advocacy on behalf of clients with service providers and government agencies.
  • Excellent organizational skills with proven follow-through on assignments, complex paperwork, and project deadlines.
  • Exceptional relational and intercultural communication skills, with an ability to build trust across diverse backgrounds.
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.
***
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

title: Import Export Executive
description:
𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗪𝗲𝗲𝗸𝗱𝗮𝘆'𝘀 𝗰𝗹𝗶𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀

𝗦𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗲: 𝗥𝘀 𝟯𝟲𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 - 𝗥𝘀 𝟰𝟮𝟬𝟬𝟬𝟬 (𝗶𝗲 𝗜𝗡𝗥 𝟯.𝟲-𝟰.𝟮 𝗟𝗣𝗔)

Experience: 1+ yrs

Location: Surat, Gujarat, India

Job Type: Full-time

We are looking for a detail-oriented Import-Export Executive to manage import-export documentation, shipment paperwork, and coordination related to factory loading, dispatch, and logistics operations.

The role is suited for someone with practical experience in import-export documentation, logistics coordination, shipping paperwork, and record management. The ideal candidate should be organised, accurate, and comfortable coordinating with internal teams, transporters, logistics partners, and external stakeholders.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle day-to-day import-export documentation and maintain accurate transaction records.
  • Prepare and maintain invoices, packing lists, shipping documents, and other logistics paperwork.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to complete documentation required for factory loading and dispatch.
  • Ensure all required documents are prepared, verified, and available before shipment or dispatch.
  • Coordinate with transporters, logistics partners, and relevant external parties for smooth dispatch operations.
  • Maintain records of import-export transactions, shipments, dispatches, and supporting documentation.
  • Track and follow up on pending shipment and dispatch-related documents.
  • Assist in coordinating import and export shipments and ensure documentation is completed within required timelines.
  • Maintain organised physical and digital filing systems for import-export and logistics documents.

  • Familiarity with invoices, packing lists, shipment documents, dispatch records, and logistics paperwork.
  • Strong documentation, filing, and record-keeping skills.
  • Good attention to detail and accuracy when handling operational documents.
  • Strong coordination and follow-up skills with internal teams, transporters, and external stakeholders.
  • Basic proficiency in MS Office, particularly MS Excel and email communication.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple documentation requirements and meet dispatch timelines.
  • Proactive approach to identifying missing information and following up for timely closure.
  • Ability to work effectively in a factory, logistics, or operations-oriented environment.
  • Graduate degree in any discipline is preferred.

title: Konelumityöntekijä

description:
Etsimme KONELUMITYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ tulevalle talvikaudelle!

Haluatko työskennellä vastuullisessa ja tärkeässä tehtävässä, jossa näet työsi tulokset heti? Haemme nyt konelumityöntekijöitä vahvistamaan talvikunnossapitotiimiämme tulevalle kaudelle!

Tässä tehtävässä tärkeintä on hyvä ajotaito, kyky työskennellä itsenäisesti, tekevä työote sekä aiempi työkokemus talvikunnossapidosta. Pääsääntöisesti auraustyöt tehdään traktorilla ja pyöräkuormaajalla. Odotamme sinulta voimassaolevaa työturvallisuuskorttia sekä vähintään B-luokan ajokorttia.

Töiden aloitus on sopimuksen mukaan heti talvikauden alussa ja töitä on tarjolla kevääseen saakka lumitilanteen mukaan. Tässä työssä vaaditaan valmiutta vuorotyöhön.

* Valmiutta vuorotyöhön

* Hyvän perehdytyksen työtehtäviin

title: Melting Tank Supervisor
description:
Why join us? At Corelle Brands (i.e., Anchor Hocking) we are passionate about products that bring joy and ease to our customers in cooking and sharing food with family and friends. Corelle Brands is home to category-leading brands, including Corelle, Corningware, Anchor Hocking, Chicago Cutlery, Fire-King, Lucaris and Ocean. We are looking for candidates who are smart, curious, creative, push the limits of what is possible and are passionate about our brands. We embrace and respect diverse backgrounds, and welcome new ideas.

Our continuous focus on growth and innovation means you will become part of a global company that offers challenging opportunities, rewards excellence, and combines your individual expertise to achieve a higher level of shared success. We operate within a fast-paced, team-oriented, rewarding work environment that allows our employees to develop and thrive.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits within a flexible, creative, and progressive work setting. Join Corelle Brands and become a part of our story. Everyone matters here.


Position Summary:


Supervise the operation of designated melting furnaces and associated equipment. To provide technical leadership to the Melting Department to improve process yields, reduce nonconformities, and reduce product cost. This is accomplished through data analysis, experimental plans, process capability studies, and variability reduction. Provide leadership and management of assigned functional responsibility such as Glass Composition, Precious Metals and Melting Critical Spares.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Monitor daily operations ensuring process stability and shift-to-shift operational consistency. Characterize and optimize daily operations.
  • Correlate glass quality and operational problems with process variables.
  • Provide training, coaching, and assessing in accordance with ISO standards for furnace/forehearth operators and other Melting personnel.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety and housekeeping guidelines.
  • Inspect process equipment and ensure problems are identified and addressed in a timely matter.
  • Work closely with the Forming department as required to ensure maximum percentage select.
  • Maintain and enforce the SOS system for the assigned unit.
  • Support tank repairs and start-ups.
  • Cross train between melting units to provide vacation, weekend, and off-shift coverage.
  • Determine and institute job change set-ups coordinating with Forming to minimize downtime and cullet at start-up.
  • Track downtime, cullet, quality, tank efficiency, and refractory wear rate ensuring objectives for each area are met.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO standards for assigned area.

  • Ensure all equipment is properly maintained and back-ups are operational.
  • To drive accountability into the operators and Tank maintenance.

  • Develop experimental plans for process improvement.
  • Uses statistics to analyze process variables.
  • Standardize process procedures in the department.
  • Support the Melting Department through weekly on-call and weekend team coverage.
  • Support project team with tank expansion, tank start-ups, and tank drains.
  • Oversee Melting Department maintenance projects.
  • Support Forming Department projects.
  • Support the Engineering team.
  • Ability to set and meet project objectives and schedules.


Required Qualifications:


  • Minimum four-year degrees in Chemical Engineering, Ceramic Engineering, Glass or other related engineering background or equivalent experience in a Melting or Process Engineering function.
  • Knowledge and experience with manufacturing processes and equipment, measurement systems, and controls.
  • Excellent data management, data analysis, and spreadsheet skills.
  • Experience with SAP a plus.
  • Collaborator with outstanding engagement and communication skills. Ability to direct and prioritize processes/project’s needs.
  • Experience with high temperature thermal processes preferred (i.e., Melting, Forming or high temperature furnaces).
  • Experience with data processing and statistical analysis preferred.
  • Travel requirement at an approximate <5%.



Our Values: We drive results and create value together One Team - We love our Consumers We “Wow” Them - We challenge each other, always have an open mindset and welcome new ideas - We are a Global Company, and we think globally - We have integrity in all that we do.

Corelle Brands is an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to diversity and inclusion. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other legally protected status. Members of all underrepresented groups are encouraged to apply.

No Recruiters, please!

Comp Range: $75k- $78,7k

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future.

title: Siivoojia teollisuuskohteeseen Raaheen
description:
Etsimme motivoituneita ja asiakaspalveluhenkisiä siivoojia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Raaheen.

Työ kohteessamme on käytännönläheistä ja vaihtelevaa. Päivittäiseen työhön kuuluu ylläpito- ja perussiivousta, ja työn jälki näkyy suoraan asiakkaalle. Tässä roolissa vastaat siitä, että tilat ovat siistit, toimivat ja turvalliset käyttää.

Työ tehdään osana tiimiä, mutta vastuu omasta jäljestä on selkeä. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta ja sitä, että tartut työhön ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta.

Jos haluat työn, jossa tekeminen näkyy heti ja jossa sinuun luotetaan, tämä paikka on sinulle.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Työssäsi vastaat osaltasi tehdasympäristön siisteydestä huolehtimalla ylläpitosiivouksesta sekä peruspesuista. Työskentelytapasi on asiakaslähtöistä ja oma-aloitteista. Viihdyt muuttuvissa tilanteissa joissa palveluhenkisyys ja tuloksellisuus ovat valttejasi.

Odotamme, että sinulta löytyy sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Toivomme, että sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta tehdassiivoustyöstä ja osaat tehdä perussiivoustöitä. Olisi myös hienoa, jos osaat käyttää yhdistelmäkoneita. Työturvallisuuskortti on pakollinen, mutta tarvittaessa koulutamme sen sinulle.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.

Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.

Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.

Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan juuri sinulle sopivalla tavalla.

RTK-Palvelu tarjoaa osaajilleen kattavan perehdytyksen ja sisäisten koulutus- ja etenemismahdollisuuksien lisäksi täyden tuen ammattitutkintojen suorittamiseen työn ohessa.

Yrityksessämme vaalitaan hyvää työilmapiiriä ja auttamisen kulttuuria – tukenasi ovat osaavat kollegat ja kannustava esihenkilö.

Meille on myös tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi! – vuosittaisessa työvirekyselyssä saimme työntekijäkokemuksesta erinomaisen arvosanan 4,1/5.

Työsuhde

Tarjoamme kokoaikaisen päivätyön ja vakituisen työsuhteen, johon noudatamme kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Jos koet hyvän työyhteisön olevan sinulle merkityksellinen, viihdyt meillä varmasti!

Lähetä hakemuksesi tai vinkkaa kaverille, toimi kuitenkin mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana. Palkkaamme henkilöt heti sopivien löydyttyä! (Emme käsittele sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia.)

Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen voi kokea olevansa arvostettu ja osallinen – siksi panostamme monimuotoisuuteen ja yhdenvertaisuuteen. Huomioimme kaikki hakijat tasapuolisesti ja toivomme hakemuksia erilaisista taustoista tulevilta henkilöiltä.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk.

We operate in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech: the emerging intersection of AI and cybersecurity. It's a market still being defined, and we're among the first to build natively for it - protecting sensitive data in real time, at the endpoint, with minimal friction for the teams using it. Enterprises get full visibility and control. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

Named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, Harmonic is gaining serious recognition and serious traction. We're led by deep cybersecurity expertise and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel.

As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work, from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

The role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who will start by owning our APIs, webhooks and integrations, and the value they deliver for customers. That means bringing Harmonic's AI Risk and Usage Intelligence into the tools our customers already use, and letting them set controls and policies without leaving their existing workflows. Over time it will also mean making it easier for partners to build with us, and shaping how AI agents connect to tools and data. You'll treat integrations as a product with real users, not just plumbing, and you'll decide which connections matter most and build them well. As Harmonic grows, we expect the scope of the role to grow with it.

The market we work in changes quickly enough that we need everyone in product to have a view on where it's heading. In this role, that view is about the ecosystem around us: which platforms our customers are standardising on and where Harmonic needs to connect to them in a year's time. We'll expect you to form that view and hold it with conviction, even when challenged by others.

What You'll Do

  • Owning our APIs, webhooks, MCP servers and integrations end to end, deciding what gets built, for whom and in what order, and being able to defend that order clearly.

  • Collaborating with our commercial and partnerships teams to understand where integrations and partner opportunities create real value for customers, and translating that into products people use.

  • Deciding which integrations are worth building and which aren't, using your judgement and understanding of our other product areas to determine where the benefits can be felt the most.

  • Holding technical conversations with engineers, both ours and those at partners and customers, covering API design, authentication, and common integration patterns to understand how systems fit together and how they might break.

  • Spending real time with existing customers and prospects, including sales calls and proof-of-value engagements where an integration can make or break a deal, and holding your own in conversations with CISOs, CIOs and their technical teams.

  • Getting hands-on yourself, whether that means calling an API to see how it really behaves, testing a webhook flow end to end, reading a partner's documentation to assess how hard an integration will be, or prototyping to test an idea before more time is committed.

  • Producing work, whether that's discovery, specifications or written thinking, that is clear and technically sound enough to stand up to scrutiny from engineers without needing to be fully rebuilt.

What You'll Bring

You've owned meaningful product work end to end and seen it through to customers, and you can talk not only about what you shipped but about whether it worked and how you knew. You have strong fundamentals to go with that: your writing is clear, your discovery is sound, your prioritisation holds up when someone pushes on it, and you take pride in your quality of work.

You're comfortable being technical. You don't need to write production code, but you're comfortable designing and critiquing APIs, you understand how webhooks, authentication and data flows work in practice, and you can work through detail confidently with engineers. You understand that the people using your products are often developers whose expectations may be very different from those of an end user. You also follow how emerging protocols such as MCP and A2A are changing the way products and AI agents connect, and use this to inform your view of how Harmonic should integrate.

You're also energised by the reality of a startup, where priorities shift, information is incomplete and you'll often need to work out the right approach as you go rather than follow one that already exists.

Nice to have

  • Experience working alongside business development or partnerships teams, and an understanding of what makes a technology partnership succeed or quietly stall.

  • Experience in B2B, particularly selling to and working with large enterprises.

  • A background in security, data protection or a related field, or familiarity with the tools enterprise security teams already run. This genuinely isn't a requirement, because we care far more about how quickly you can get to grips with a domain than whether you already know this one.

  • You live and breathe AI trends and latest developments to apply it directly in your role

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.

  • Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits - pension plan and flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites - past trips include Lisbon, Portugal and Nashville, TN

  • Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

description:

Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

Location: Pittsburgh, PA (Hybrid)

Classification: Exempt

Status: Full-time

Purpose

The Financial Data Analyst plays a key role in transforming financial data into actionable business insights. This position analyzes complex datasets, develops financial models and reporting solutions, identifies trends and opportunities, and supports data-driven decision-making. The role partners with cross-functional teams to improve data integrity, reporting efficiency, and business performance.

This position is open to remote candidates. Up to 10% travel may be required. Candidates located in the Pittsburgh, PA area will be expected to follow the company's hybrid work model.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with IT, Accounting, Controlling, and cross-functional teams to gather, validate, reconcile, and analyze financial data across the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) and financial systems. Perform root cause analysis, resolve data discrepancies, and ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial reporting and analytics.
  • Utilize SQL, Databricks, and other data platforms to extract, transform, analyze, and validate financial data from multiple sources.
  • Leverage Power BI and other analytical tools to develop dashboards, visualizations, and scalable reporting solutions that transform complex financial data into actionable insights. Identifies opportunities to automate and streamline reporting and analytical processes to improve efficiency and data accuracy.
  • Assists in the financial planning process, including budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
  • Assists in developing and maintaining financial models and tools to support business performance and decision-making.
  • Conducts comprehensive financial analysis, identifies trends, and provides strategic insights to senior management.
  • Provides insightful analysis regarding period over period and actual vs. forecast performance; continually improves and manages variance analyses reporting.
  • Monitors key financial metrics, proactively identifies areas of concern, and recommends appropriate actions.
  • Develops a deep understanding of business drivers at both the product and overall enterprise levels.
  • Plays a key role in supporting growth, efficiency and value-maximizing initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in financial planning and analysis or similar role.
  • Proficiency in financial analysis tools, such as Excel, and experience working with financial planning software.
  • Self-starter who can deliver in a dynamic environment under tight timelines and changing priorities.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and present actionable insights.
  • A proven ability to effectively communicate complex concepts in a simple manner.
  • High sense of accountability and urgency.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and data integrity.
  • Positive attitude and strong work ethic.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within the specialty pharmacy or a related healthcare field.

Work Environment

This position operates in a home or professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets and fax machines.

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, see, talk, or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Visual acuity is necessary for tasks such as reading or working with various forms of data for extended periods of time on a computer screen. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Benefits:

PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy also affords an excellent benefit package, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, health savings and flexible spending accounts, 401K with employer matching, employer-paid life insurance and short/long term disability coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program! Generous paid time off is also available to all full-time employees. Of course we offer paid holidays too!

Equal Opportunity:

PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer, and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotions or any term or condition of employment based on race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran's status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Water Resources Engineer - Mid to Senior Level
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. M&N also delivers large Navy and transportation projects including roadway and rail projects. We are actively looking for a Water Resources Engineer to join our San Diego office. As part of the Water Resources Group, the Water Resources Engineer will be expected to: develop surface water hydraulic, hydrologic, and hydrodynamic modeling; perform engineering calculations to solve problems related to surface water and drainage; analyze system flow, flood risk, and mitigation alternatives; address the prevention of flood damage and ensure compliance with local, state, and federal flood management regulations; prepare exhibits, reports, and presentations to illustrate findings and recommendations; prepare plans, specifications, estimates, and other documents; and liaise with different individuals and agencies, including government agencies, local authorities, and contractors.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specializing in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbors and rivers, as well as an innovator in transportation. For the 5th year in a row, Moffatt & Nichol is Ranked #1 in Engineering News-Record for Marine & Port Facilities in the U.S. Additionally, our firm consistently ranks in the Top 100 Pure Designers in the US and the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, North America, Latin America, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customized service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in several primary practice areas – ports and harbors; coastal, environmental and water resources; urban waterfronts and marinas; transportation, bridges and rail; inspection and rehabilitation; and energy.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

  • Serves as technical lead on projects and, as appropriate, oversees junior engineering staff on projects that include surface water hydrology & hydraulics, flood risk management, and estuarine/ coastal restoration and protection.
  • Perform numerical modeling in support of stormwater and drainage improvement projects
  • Perform 1D and 2D riverine hydraulic modeling
  • Prepare plans, specifications, and cost estimates, in support of final bid packages
  • Participate in design activities and meetings between project team members, subcontractors, and client managers
  • Participate in project decisions regarding technical approaches, feasibility, cost, construction approaches, and scheduling performance
  • Prepares graphics, reports, and presentations
  • Resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways

Other Duties:

Please note this job posting is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor of Science in Civil or Environmental Engineering; required
    • Master of Science; preferred
  • 5 - 10+ years of related experience; required
  • Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification; required
  • Professional Engineer registration (PE); preferred
  • Broad expertise or unique knowledge; uses skills to contribute to development of company objectives to achieve goals in creative and effective ways.
  • Ability to establish effective working relationships with team members and project managers
  • Background and/or experience with engineering analysis and design of various project types including a combination of:
    • Floodplain mapping and floodplain management and compliance with FEMA Floodplain Regulations and Standards
    • Stormwater hydrology and hydraulic modeling; stormwater and drainage infrastructure permitting and design
    • Watershed assessment & planning
    • Flood protection and resilience
    • Low impact development/green infrastructure
    • Preparing project scope and fee proposals
    • Construction principles, including survey, inspection, and engineering methods and materials, and surveying methods and techniques
  • Desired working knowledge of software programs and techniques includes:
  • HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, SWMM/XPSWMM/PCSWMM, WSPGW, Inforworks ICM, ESRI GIS, AutoCADD Civil 3D, Microsoft Office
  • All new hires will be required to successfully complete and pass a pre-employment (post offer) background check in compliance with NIST 800-171
  • Moffatt & Nichol uses E-Verify and employment is contingent upon the legal ability to obtain employment in the U.S. and to present the required documentation at hire

Working Conditions:

Majority of work is office based. Some site visits may be required which may necessitate navigating unpaved or natural terrain while carrying equipment.

Base Salary Range:

$120,000 to $180,000 per hour based on years of experience, level of education obtained, professional registration, and meeting the required qualifications in the job description.

Base salary range only applicable for candidates who will be hired and working in the California market.

Moffatt & Nichol’s Employment Benefits:

At Moffatt & Nichol, we genuinely care about our team and strive to create a warm, welcoming environment. We’re excited to offer a range of great benefits and cover many costs to support you. Here are some highlights:

Our philosophy is simple - provide value to our clients through the ability to streamline, measure, and improve their business processes via business intelligence and business architecture. Our expertise has proven highly successful in helping organizations recognize greater value by aligning their strategy and objectives to technology and execution.

Scope of Work: U.S. Transportation Command (USTRANSCOM) is the single manager for global patient movement for the Department of War (DoW), responsible for synchronizing transportation and medical evacuation to provide life‑saving care to warfighters across the spectrum of military operations. TRAC2ES is a critical system for the DoW supporting global patient movement operations by integrating medical regulating, patient evacuation, and command and control decision support, ensuring efficient and secure patient movement across peace, war, and contingency scenarios. TRAC2ES handles sensitive data, including Personal Identifiable Information (PII) and Protected Health Information (PHI), and operates within both classified and unclassified environments. USTRANSCOM seeks innovative solutions to enhance, sustain, and modernize TRAC2ES. The solution must address challenges in scalability, performance, cybersecurity, interoperability, and operational efficiency while ensuring compliance with DoW standards. Additionally, the solution must include options for transitioning TRAC2ES functionality to a secure, user‑friendly mobile application to improve accessibility and operational efficiency in diverse operational environments. The solution must optimize TRAC2ES's capabilities to meet evolving mission requirements while ensuring compliance with DoW standards, including Zero Trust (ZT) principles.

title: Vaativan tason elementtiasennustyönjohtaja
description:

Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme vaativan tason elementtiasennustyönjohtajaa Ouluun! Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä työmaan muun työnjohdon, suunnittelijoiden, elementtitoimittajien, asennusurakoitsijoiden ja muiden hankkeen osapuolten kanssa.

Valittu henkilö rekrytoituu suoraan asiakasyrityksellemme vakituiseksi työntekijäksi. Palkkaus sovitaan kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi pohjautuen, töiden aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Hakemuksia käsitellään jo hakuaikana, paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Odotamme sinulta:

* Tehtävään soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa

* Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja organisointitaitoja
* Itsenäistä, järjestelmällistä ja vastuullista työskentelyotetta

title: Ruokapalvelutyöntekijä, Fodbar, Liminka
description:
Haluatko tehdä työtä, jolla on merkitystä joka päivä? Fodbar vastaa ruokapalveluista Limingan Joutsenkodissa ja haemme nyt vakituista työntekijää kohteeseen. Ruokapalvelutyöntekijänä varmistat, että asukkaat saavat hyvää, ravitsevaa ja laadukasta ruokaa - ja sen vaikutuksen näet heti.

Fodbar on innovatiivinen ruokapalveluyritys, joka yhdistää vuosikymmenien alan kokemuksen ja tuoreen ajattelun. Toiminnan ytimessä on halu tarjota aidosti hyvää ruokaa ja palvelua.

RUOKAPALVELUTYÖNTEKIJÄN TYÖTEHTÄVÄT

- Valmistat ja lämmität ruokia keittiössä päivittäisten ohjeiden mukaan
- Tarjoilet ruoan asukkaille huolellisesti ja asiakaslähtöisesti
- Huolehdit erikoisruokavalioiden toteutumisesta oikein ja turvallisesti
- Pidät keittiön tilat siistinä ja järjestyksessä
- Huolehdit astiahuollosta osana keittiön päivittäistä toimintaa

SINULTA EDELLYTETÄÄN

- Hyvä asenne ja aito halu oppia uutta
- Huolellisuus ja ripeys käytännön työssä
- Joustavuus - myös viikonlopputyövuorot kuuluvat kuvioon
- Kyky toimia osana tiimiä ja tarttuminen reippaasti erilaisiin päivän tilanteisiin
- Sujuva suomen kielen taito, hygieniapassi ja terveydentilaselvitys (koskien pakkaamattomien elintarvikkeiden käsittelyä)

- Aiempi kokemus ruokapalvelu-, ravintola- tai hoiva-alan tehtävistä tai alan koulutus

- Ajokortti

Aiempaa kokemusta ei kuitenkaan vaadita - tärkeintä on oikea asenne, ja perehdytämme sinut tehtävään.

Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja työtunteja on 112,5 h / 3 viikon jaksolla. Työvuorot sijoittuvat klo 9.30-17.30 sekä arkipäiville että viikonlopuille.

Huomioithan, että tietoturvasyistä emme käsittele sähköpostihakemuksia, joten hakemukset tulee jättää ilmoituksen kautta. Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten hae rohkeasti jo tänään. Et tarvitse täydellisiä papereita - hyvä asenne riittää alkuun!

title: Employee Experience Administrator
description:
Position Function:

Supports the design, implementation, coordination, and measurement of employee experience, employee engagement, recognition, culture, and change management initiatives across the organization. This position serves as a key program management resource for the Chief Happiness Officer by helping administer employee engagement programs, coordinating employee experience initiatives, supporting organizational communications, and providing reporting, analytics, and operational support that strengthen employee engagement and organizational effectiveness.

Performs all duties and interacts with internal and external customers in a manner that is expressly aligned with the Company's Core Values of approaching all actions with a “Voyaging Spirit” and being “Positively Ohana”. Exhibits core competencies that result in consistent delivery of positive Customer Interactions, Empowerment and Ownership and demonstrates key professional and performance skills such as Active Listening, effective Oral and Written Communication, Action and Solution Oriented and Thoroughness.

Primary Accountabilities:

  • Employee Experience & Engagement Programs
    • Support administration of employee engagement surveys and employee listening initiatives.
    • Coordinate survey communications, timelines, participation tracking, and follow-up activities.
    • Compile and analyze engagement data, trends, and employee feedback.
    • Prepare dashboards, reports, presentations, and leadership insights.
    • Support leaders in developing and tracking engagement action plans.
    • Assist with employee recognition, employee experience, and culture initiatives.
  • Change Management & Communications
    • Coordinate change management activities associated with organizational initiatives.
    • Assist with communication planning, employee readiness activities, and stakeholder engagement efforts.
    • Draft and distribute communication materials supporting employee experience and organizational change initiatives.
    • Maintain project plans, communication calendars, milestones, and status updates.
    • Monitor participation, adoption, and employee feedback related to change initiatives..
  • Employee Activities, Recognition & Culture Programs
    • Coordinate employee activities, events, recognition programs, and culture-building initiatives.
    • Manage logistics, vendors, schedules, communications, and event materials.
    • Maintain annual employee experience and recognition calendars.
    • Collect participation metrics and feedback to improve future programs and events.
  • Reporting, Project Coordination & Administration
    • Maintain reporting tools, project trackers, documentation, and program records.
    • Coordinate meetings, action items, and follow-up activities.
    • Support presentations, program updates, and recurring reporting.
    • Provide operational support for broader HR initiatives as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalency required.
  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited 4-year university, preferably in a related field preferred.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of HR, employee experience or related work experience required.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform light physical work and to move or lift items including but not limited to boxes, files and papers up to 20 pounds unless otherwise as indicated.
  • Must be able to operate and proficiently use standard office equipment, including phone, copier, personal computer and/or other work related mechanical or electronic devices and applications.
  • Must be able to clearly communicate verbally and in writing with all internal and external customers. Must also be able to hear sufficiently to engage in daily discussions and interactions.
  • Must be able to read and understand bank-related documents.
  • Must be able to work in a conventional office setting, involving sitting at a desk or workstation for long periods of time. Must also be able to adapt to different work environments as needed to perform the job.


We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.

title: Luokanopettaja, Jäälin koulu
description:

Jäälin koulussa opiskelee noin 630 oppilasta luokilla 1-9. Yleisopetusluokkien lisäksi koulullamme toimii kuusi alueellista vaativan erityisentuen pienluokkaa (VET-luokat), valmistavan opetuksen VALO-luokka sekä joustavan perusopetuksen JOPO-luokka. Monitoimitalossa sijaitsevat myös nuorisotilat ja kirjasto. Koulu ja nuorisopalvelut toimivat yhteistyössä tukien lasten ja nuorten ehjän koulupäivän toteutumista.

Haemme joukkoomme pedagogisesti vahvaa ja yhteistyötaitoista luokanopettajaa, jolla on valmiuksia toimia tiiviissä tiimityössä sekä toteuttaa tavoitteellista yhteisopettajuutta.

Kelpoisuusehdot määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen 986/1998 mukaisesti. Kelpoisuuden osoittavat alkuperäiset tutkintotodistukset esitetään mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

Eduksi luetaan kyky englannin kielen opetukseen vuosiluokilla 1-6.

Palkkaus määräytyy kunnallisen opetusalan virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

Tehtävään valitun on ennen valinnan vahvistamista, viimeistään 30 päivän kuluessa valintapäätöksen tiedoksisaannista, esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) 3 §:n mukainen rikostaustaote. Tehtävässä käytetään koeaikaa.

Tehtävää haetaan ensisijaisesti sähköisellä hakulomakkeella. Mikäli hakemusta ei ole mahdollista jättää sähköisesti, toimita hakemus osoitteeseen Oulun kaupungin kirjaamo, PL 71, 90015 Oulun kaupunki, käyntiosoite Kansankatu 55 A. Hakemuksessa on mainittava tehtäväkohtainen diaarinumero OUKA/12919/2026 sekä lähetyskuoressa haettavana olevan viran nimi. Haettaessa useampia virkoja on jokaiseen virkaan toimitettava oma hakemus. Oulun kaupunki ei käytä tekoälyä hakemusten käsittelyssä. Hakemus on toimitettava 5.10.2026 klo 16.15 mennessä.

title: Lastenpsykiatrian erikoislääkäri, Rovaniemi/Kemi/Tornio
description:
Pohjoisessa työ ja elämä kulkevat samaa latua. Lapin hyvinvointialueella tulet osaksi tiivistä työyhteisöä, jossa hommat hoidetaan titteleihin katsomatta ja yhteen hiileen puhaltaen. Lapin upea luonto, ainutlaatuiset maisemat ja mahdollisuudet urakehitykseen antavat elämään huippuhetkiä. Me annamme tilaa ja tukea, jotta sinä voit kulkea itsesi näköisen polun.

Lastenpsykiatrina pääset tekemään merkityksellistä erikoissairaanhoidon työtä osana osaavaa moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Tarjoamme joustavia työn tekemisen mahdollisuuksia, mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työnkuvaasi sekä työmäärältään kohtuullisen työn ja vahvan kollegiaalisen tuen. Kuuntele sydämesi ääntä - tule lastenpsykiatriksi Lappiin!

Lapin hyvinvointialueella Lasten- ja nuorisopsykiatrian vastuuyksikössä on haettavana kaksi lastenpsykiatrian erikoislääkärin toistaiseksi voimassa oleva virkaa sijoittuen poliklinikoille Rovaniemelle ja Kemiin/ Tornioon.

Lasten- ja nuorisopsykiatrian vastuuyksikkö muodostaa koko Lapin alueen kattavan erikoissairaanhoidon kokonaisuuden. Siihen kuuluu Lapin keskussairaalan lasten- ja nuorisopsykiatrian poliklinikat ja osastot ja Länsi-Pohjan sairaalan lasten- ja nuorisopsykiatrian poliklinikka, jonka toimipaikat ovat Kemissä ja Torniossa.

Lastenpsykiatrian erikoislääkärin työ painottuu kliiniseen potilastyöhön lastenpsykiatrian poliklinikalla osana moniammatillista työryhmää. Erikoislääkärinä vastaat omien potilaidesi tutkimuksesta, hoidosta ja seurannasta. Tehtäviin voidaan suunnitella lisäksi perustason mielenterveyspalveluihin ja perheneuvolaan suuntautuvaa työtä kiinnostuksesi mukaisesti. Viikkotyöaika on 38,25 tuntia, ja työ on päivätyötä maanantaista perjantaihin. Tarjoamme joustavia työn tekemisen mahdollisuuksia, mukaan lukien osittaisen etätyömahdollisuuden. Myös osa-aikatyöstä voidaan sopia.

Kelpoisuusehtona on oikeus harjoittaa lastenpsykiatrian erikoislääkärin ammattia laillistettuna ammattihenkilönä. Mikäli soveltuvaa kelpoisuusehdot täyttävää hakijaa ei ole saatavilla, voidaan tehtävään määräajaksi ottaa myös lastenpsykiatriaan erikoistuva lääkäri.

Palkkaus ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät lääkärisopimuksen mukaan. Virkasuhteessa noudatetaan koeaikaa 6kk.
Henkilöstön rokotussuojan osalta noudatamme työn ja tartuntatautilain edellyttämää rokotussuojaa. Valitun tulee esittää rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote ennen tehtävän aloittamista.

Tehtävään haetaan sähköisellä hakulomakkeella Kuntarekry-palvelussa 18.11.2026 klo 15:00 mennessä.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Officer (On-Site)
description:
We’re looking for a financial professional who is looking to help build a stronger foundation, sharpen our focus to connect management reporting to business outcomes, and strengthen our capabilities.

Sound like you? Come grow with us – we’d love to meet you!

Position Function:

Support the Company's annual budgeting process by coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and presenting key assumptions and financial projections to senior leadership. Drive strategic decision-making by providing in-depth financial analysis, identifying trends, and offering actionable insights to optimize performance. Maintain a deep understanding of banking industry financial statements and market dynamics to guide business strategy and financial planning. This position will report to the FP&A Manager.

Performs all duties and interacts with internal and external customers in a manner that is expressly aligned with the Company's Core Values of approaching all actions with a “Voyaging Spirit” and being “Positively Ohana”. Exhibits core competencies that result in consistent delivery of positive Customer Interactions, Empowerment and Ownership and demonstrates key professional and performance skills such as Active Listening, effective Oral and Written Communication, Action and Solution Oriented and Thoroughness.


Primary Accountabilities:

  • Budgeting/Planning and Forecasting
    • Support the annual budgeting process.
    • Lead monthly/quarterly forecasting process that informs quarterly earnings.
    • Participate in month end accounting close to review preliminary results on behalf of LOBs and in context of budget
    • Proactively work with senior management, sales teams and support centers to establish an annual budget and performance measurements at the total bank, LOB levels, and other levels of the organization as requested by management.
    • Ensure lines of business understand and are committed to their budgets.
    • Drive the process to analyze budget variances and recommend actions to improve performance.
  • Financial Analysis and Business Partner Responsibilities
    • Serve as FP&A Business Partner to assigned lines of business.
    • Analyze trends and conduct root-cause analysis when results diverge from expectations.
    • Analyze and develop financial analysis pro-formas to guide management decisions on whether to pursue branch location lease renewals, purchases, new projects and initiatives.
    • Develop and continuously improve financial performance reports to deliver information to stakeholders in a relevant and timely manner.
    • Analyze industry and peer approaches to financial analysis.
    • Demonstrate thorough understanding of assigned lines of business and make recommendations on how to improve their profitability.
    • Serve as a champion on profitability and foster a culture where profitability is at the core of analysis and reporting.
  • Data Governance and System Administration
    • Uphold a strong standard for data accuracy and reliability and work with other departments to ensure consistency in framework for reporting.
    • Serve as Administrator for Syntellis Axiom Enterprise Performance Management Software Platform, ensuring all policies and procedures are maintained and up-to-date, loading and validating data imports, table maintenance, and managing security.
  • Leadership
    • Collaborate across all lines of business to drive strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and financial objectives.
    • Champion continuous improvement by evaluating processes, identifying efficiency opportunities, and implementing best practices to enhance financial operations.
    • Deliver clear, impactful financial reports and presentations, translating performance metrics, cost management strategies, and growth opportunities into actionable insights.
    • Proven ability to manage projects involving multiple stakeholders, ensuring seamless execution and alignment across teams.


Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalency required.
  • Bachelor's Degree from an accredited 4-year university in finance or Accounting or equivalent experience preferred.
  • Master’s Degree preferred.

Experience:

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in accounting, budgeting, forecasting, management or financial reporting required.
  • Microsoft Power BI and Power Automate preferred to build automated reports, streamline budget data, and create live financial dashboards

License/Certification:

  • CPA or MBA preferred.

Physical Requirements & Working Conditions:

  • Must be able to perform light physical work and to move or lift items including but not limited to boxes, files and papers up to 20 pounds unless otherwise as indicated.
  • Must be able to operate and proficiently use standard office equipment, including phone, copier, personal computer and/or other work related mechanical or electronic devices and applications.
  • Must be able to clearly communicate verbally and in writing with all internal and external customers. Must also be able to hear sufficiently to engage in daily discussions and interactions.
  • Must be able to read and understand bank-related documents.
  • Must be able to work in a conventional office setting, involving sitting at a desk or workstation for long periods of time. Must also be able to adapt to different work environments as needed to perform the job.


We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.

title: Senior Java Engineer
description:
Senior Java Developer Business Unit: FTSE Russell – Index Platform Company: London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG)

About Us

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity. LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

Our People

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential. We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and hands‑on Senior Java Engineer with AI proficiency to help build the next generation FTSE Russell Index Platform. This platform underpins the calculation and distribution of FTSE Russell’s global family of indexes and requires advanced engineering, high precision data processing, and deep collaboration across global teams. This is a deeply technical role focused on designing, building, integrating, and operationalising modern software and AI driven capabilities across internal platforms and client facing products. You will work with innovative technologies, contribute to complex algorithmic design, and drive engineering excellence in a high performance, data intensive environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain complex Java and Python applications using modern engineering practices.
  • Build / embed AI powered features into mission critical systems.
  • Architect and enhance services that support largescale, performance critical index computations.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, UX, and engineering teams globally to deliver high quality products.
  • Lead projects end-to-end through requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites to ensure performance, scalability, and security.
  • Diagnose production issues, identify root causes, and deliver Level 3 support and fixes.
  • Conduct peer reviews, provide technical leadership, and mentor junior engineers.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 10+ years of hands‑on backend software engineering experience.
  • Support the organisation’s AI adoption journey.
  • Develop and enhance intelligent solutions using LLMs, LangChain/LangGraph, and agentic AI frameworks.
  • Establish engineering best practices for safe, scalable, traceable and production ready AI deployments across internal platforms and external product suites.
  • Strong algorithms, data structures, problem solving skills, and ability to translate business problems into scalable solutions.
  • Good command of coding standards and Strong understanding of both high level and low level software design.
  • Expertise in: Core Java, Python Building highly distributed, data intensive systems Microservices, REST APIs RDBMS (Oracle/SQL Server/Postgres) CI/CD tools (Jenkins/GitLab), DevOps automation Docker, Kubernetes JVM profiling & performance optimisation Prior exposure to Level 3 production support.

Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Skills

  • Experience leading or mentoring a team of engineers.
  • Experience within financial services or with financial market data.
  • Familiarity with in‑memory caching, Spring Boot, Redis, Kafka.
  • Experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber, JBehave, or Karate.
  • Background as a Scrum Master or experience running Agile teams.

What We’re Looking For

A proactive, creative engineering leader who enjoys solving complex problems, working hands‑on with modern technologies, and driving AI enabled innovation. If you’re passionate about building resilient, intelligent, data intensive systems that power global financial markets, we’d love to hear from you.
